claimBoundary: These are explicit candidate links between official objectives and the authored lesson. They do not establish legal correctness, instructional sufficiency, practical competence, instructor approval, or human learning.

source.trafficAct: Færdselsloven, LBK nr. 118 af 12. januar 2026, § 26, stk. 6, 2. og 5. pkt.; jf. § 17, stk. 1, og § 16, stk. 2

stageContract.risk: Actual cyclist image-point selection, with an accessible text alternative, records the relevant cycle-track hazard.
stageContract.decision: Wrong turn/horn paths are recorded and repaired; the first decision remains preserved.
stageContract.consequence: Safe playback shows the cyclist clear before proceeding; unsafe playback stops before contact.
stageContract.transfer: Driveway transfer uses a different geometry and requires renewed observation and yielding.
stageContract.contrast: After transfer, the learner distinguishes safe proceed after a renewed check from always-wait or skip-check answers.
stageContract.recall: Typed free recall is shown back to the learner as an explicit self-report and is not independently scored.
stageContract.completion: The final table preserves first errors, repairs, transfer, and self-report separately from mastery.

objectives.ruleAction: A cyclist can remain in the conflict path even when an obstacle or blind angle hides the cyclist.
Before turning right across the cycle track, establish the cyclist's position and the crossing path.

objectives.role: mirror and blind-angle checks before positioning
objectives.ruleAction: Check mirrors and the blind angle before positioning for the turn.
Repeat the rearward and blind-angle check immediately before crossing the cycle track.
Do not treat a missing reflection as proof that the cycle track is clear; search again before turning.
Hold back and let a cyclist continuing straight pass before completing the right turn.

objectives.role: do not inconvenience cyclist continuing straight
objectives.ruleAction: A right turn must not force a straight-ahead cyclist to brake, stop, or change line; wait until the crossing path is free.
validationRefs: tests/turn-learning.test.mjs: repairs never overwrite first answers
